Madam/ Sir, 
 
Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015  
Outcome of Interaction with Institutional Investors  
 
With reference to letter No. CC/S&B/AND/2026-27/429 dated 19.09.2026 regarding 
interaction with the institutional investors/ analysts, we inform that the representatives 
of State Bank of India had the group investor interaction on 25th September 2026 
virtually arranged by CITI (Citi India Financials Investor Forum). List of the participants 
is placed as Annexure. 
 
Only information available in the public domain was given to the investor. 
 
Yours faithfully,
